ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal lobe tips and 65% low-intensity black pixels forming the central fluke body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal left lobe (viewer left) contains a large, roughly rectangular high-intensity white patch with internal black mottling and vertical striations. Distal right lobe (viewer right) contains a triangular high-intensity white wedge tapering towards the central body. The central 2/3 of the fluke surface is composed of a contiguous low-intensity black pixel mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined, deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex angle and symmetric lobe divergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the inner edge of the left lobe and the outer edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a broad convex curve from the notch towards the tips, with localized concavity (recurvature) observed at the far distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of approximately 25-30 discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (ranging 5-12 pixels in diameter) scattered across the black central region, resembling a constellation pattern.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation on the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive heterogeneous, high-intensity texture clusters indicative of barnacle colonization on both the left and right distal tips. A prominent notch/irregularity is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique line of four high-contrast white circular spots arranged in a near-vertical linear formation on the lower-center of the left lobe.
